title: Show HN: I reverse engineered Apple's video wallpapers
summary: Developer reverse engineered Apple's WallpaperExtensionKit.framework to enable custom video wallpapers on macOS, created a product called Phosphene, and open-sourced it after finding market competition too polished to compete with profitably.
problem_solved: Enables custom video wallpapers on macOS where Apple only provides limited built-in options.
why_valuable: Gives users freedom to customize their desktop with video wallpapers and provides reverse engineering insights for Apple's private APIs.
